Copied from kora_theme branch theme-fonts-20261102 at commit d21375a (will be on main once merged): theme.css, theme.js, theme.json, vite-plugin.mjs and the fonts/ directory (fonts.css, catalog.json, the woff2 files and their OFL.txt licences), byte-identical to that resource so CI can build without access to that private repo. theme.json is the single source of truth for colours and default fonts; theme.js reads it, resolved next to its own script URL. Production reads the live cfx-nui-kora_theme; the dev server serves theme.js, theme.css, theme.json and fonts/ from /@kora_theme.
Remove once the release workflow can clone kora_theme (KORA_THEME_TOKEN secret) and point web/vite.config.ts back at ../../kora_theme.
